units.source_text: 嘎尔目看着侍者的背影走远，神情半哭不笑的。

en.t: Geeru watched the attendant's back recede into the distance, with an expression that was neither crying nor smiling.

units.source_text: 我看着他的脸，发现不知从何时起，我已经深深憎恨上这个玻璃公司老板了。

en.t: As I looked at his face, I realized that at some point I had come to hate this glass company owner deeply.

units.source_text: 可是现在的嘎尔并不是以大资本家的身份，而只是以一个普通河童的身份站在我身旁。

en.t: But the Geeru beside me now was not standing there as a great capitalist, but only as an ordinary kappa.

units.source_text: 我从花瓶里取出冬蔷薇递给嘎尔。

en.t: I took a winter rose from the vase and handed it to Geeru.
